title: Darlington I iRacing Pro Track Guide by TCSP I NASCAR O'Reilly Series

corners.label: T1
corners.line: Stay on throttle through compression zone
corners.mistakes: Getting too free in the compression zone

corners.label: T1
corners.braking: lift at third red before Cookout logo
corners.mistakes: overdrive compression zone, lift at Cookout logo

corners.braking: lift earlier to manage car balance

corners.label: T1
corners.line: turn-in on seam, apex on seam, line through corner maintaining balance
corners.exit: throttle ramp up through compression zone, aim for center of turn one and two
corners.mistakes: don't hit splitter edge, avoid pushing fronts to wall too early

corners.label: T1
corners.mistakes: stressing the tire out, carrying too much speed

corners.label: T2
corners.mistakes: being at the wall at full throttle

corners.exit: partial throttle, may lift to pivot
corners.mistakes: sliding the fronts, not turning away from the wall

corners.label: T2
corners.line: Turn down the hill, straddle the seam splitter.
corners.exit: Maintain exit velocity, use micro adjustments of counter steering.
corners.mistakes: Modulating throttle too much, not crossing seams smoothly.

corners.label: T3
corners.braking: brake at the point where the wall opens up
corners.line: use extra radius to widen entry

corners.label: T3
corners.braking: Smooth braking, get left front on seam.
corners.line: Use references, turn in early, roll through.
corners.exit: Off brake early, back to throttle before Cookout logo.
corners.mistakes: Too much initial throttle can cause drift, lose control.

corners.braking: More braking. Same braking points a lot longer on like a 70 to 80% range of throttle.
corners.line: Manage less throttle in this whole phase. Wait longer to full throttle.
corners.mistakes: Rushing the process, picking up the throttle too early.

corners.line: turn-in to left throttle, cross seam
corners.exit: open wheel up as soon as possible
corners.mistakes: get free crossing seam, use full throttle too early

corners.braking: Same breaking point, heavy peak pressure
corners.line: Get to the bottom a little earlier, straighter approach
corners.exit: Slow 80% throttle, 90% throttle, full throttle on exit
corners.mistakes: Balancing the car incorrectly on exit

corners.braking: Brake before crossing yellow line, off brake by cone.
corners.line: Point before cone, delay angle entry, shape angle to racing line.
corners.mistakes: Slipping, locking left and right front wheels.

general_tips: Look for markers to understand the track
keep left and right rear wheels turning at the same rate
mitigate car balance by adjusting lift point
back lift point up if feeling free on entry
carry momentum, find the point to work up to the wall
place all four tires just above the seam at the top
keep the car turning away from the wall
be precise with left side placement above the seam
decrease throttle to pivot away from the wall
Keep it smooth, find displacement of left front.
modulate throttle as right rear crosses seam
peek up to wall at Cookout logo on exit of turn two
Maintain balance and keep the radius longer.
lift to manage compression zone, use less maintenance throttle
Maintain lateral grip, avoid pushing up early
